metadata.description: cc10x v12.9.1 - The Loop Engine: a harness for Claude Code. One router sends each request to one of eight workflows (build, debug, review, plan, QA, orient, triage, codebase health) run by specialist subagents, with fail-closed gates, workflow artifacts on disk, hook guardrails, test honesty gates, fresh-context verification, and memory that survives compaction.
